review_description: Absolutle legends, they arrived at my house up in Caboolture at 6:30am, even though they live down in redland bay they told me, ready to start the day and pumped out my new system in just 6 hours. Super clean and super quick.
Alex from Solar Flow was very helpful and after a site visit he worked through a number of options with us until we landed on the ideal system to suit us. The installers were fantastic too.
